name: claimstate
description: Privacy-preserving obligation state envelope and one in-network operational reservation on Hedera.

envVars.description: Hedera testnet operator account id in 0.0.x form. Not a secret.
Hex-encoded 32-byte ECDSA private key for the operator. Leave empty in the example. Store the real key only in .env.local.
EVM chain id. This template accepts 296 (Hedera testnet) only.
Hedera JSON-RPC URL. Public Hashio is for development only. Default https://testnet.hashio.io/api.
Mirror Node REST base URL. Testnet default https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com.

steps.label: Configure the operator
steps.text: Copy .env.example to .env.local. Set the Hedera testnet operator id and ECDSA key there. Do not commit .env.local.
